coverage.negative: forbid semantic ranking, model training, corpus parsing, DPO, model mutation, JSON/PS1/report substitute, and final/cross-host claim
coverage.untrained_honesty: semantic_quality_claimed remains false for QA fixtures
coverage.trained_acceptance: not assessed in HOST-08F; trained-unit quality remains covered by earlier core gates
coverage.regression: covers prompt-to-task, orchestration-plan, skill-selection, debug disabled/enabled, and redaction at component level

required_distinctions.codex_exec_model_backed_qa: false unless codex exec is actually used and exact prompt/content is recorded
